verses.pali: Aṅguttara Nikāya 4.135
14. Puggalavagga
Sāvajjasutta
“Cattārome, bhikkhave, puggalā santo saṁvijjamānā lokasmiṁ.
verses.english: “Mendicants, these four individuals are found in the world.

verses.pali: Katame cattāro?
Sāvajjo, vajjabahulo, appavajjo, anavajjo.
verses.english: The blameworthy, the mostly blameworthy, the slightly blameworthy, and the blameless.

verses.pali: Kathañca, bhikkhave, puggalo sāvajjo hoti?
verses.english: And how is an individual blameworthy?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo sāvajjena kāyakammena samannāgato hoti, sāvajjena vacīkammena samannāgato hoti, sāvajjena manokammena samannāgato hoti.
verses.english: It’s when an individual does things by way of body, speech, and mind that are blameworthy.

verses.pali: Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo sāvajjo hoti.
verses.english: That’s how an individual is blameworthy.

verses.pali: Kathañca, bhikkhave, puggalo vajjabahulo hoti?
verses.english: And how is an individual mostly blameworthy?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo sāvajjena bahulaṁ kāyakammena samannāgato hoti, appaṁ anavajjena;
verses.english: It’s when an individual does things by way of body, speech, and mind that are mostly blameworthy, but occasionally blameless.

verses.pali: sāvajjena bahulaṁ vacīkammena samannāgato hoti, appaṁ anavajjena;
sāvajjena bahulaṁ manokammena samannāgato hoti, appaṁ anavajjena.
Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo vajjabahulo hoti.
verses.english: That’s how an individual is mostly blameworthy.

verses.pali: Kathañca, bhikkhave, puggalo appavajjo hoti?
verses.english: And how is an individual slightly blameworthy?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo anavajjena bahulaṁ kāyakammena samannāgato hoti, appaṁ sāvajjena;
verses.english: It’s when an individual does things by way of body, speech, and mind that are mostly blameless, but occasionally blameworthy.

verses.pali: anavajjena bahulaṁ vacīkammena samannāgato hoti, appaṁ sāvajjena;
anavajjena bahulaṁ manokammena samannāgato hoti, appaṁ sāvajjena.
Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo appavajjo hoti.
verses.english: That’s how an individual is slightly blameworthy.

verses.pali: Kathañca, bhikkhave, puggalo anavajjo hoti?
verses.english: And how is an individual blameless?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo anavajjena kāyakammena samannāgato hoti, anavajjena vacīkammena samannāgato hoti, anavajjena manokammena samannāgato hoti.
verses.english: It’s when an individual does things by way of body, speech, and mind that are blameless.

verses.pali: Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo anavajjo hoti.
verses.english: That’s how an individual is blameless.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro puggalā santo saṁvijjamānā lokasmin”ti.
verses.english: These are the four individuals found in the world.”

verses.pali: Pañcamaṁ.
